title: ExecutionContracts

stateMutationRule.description: A consequential state mutation is accepted only after the event envelope, identity, authority, policy and execution preconditions validate; the durable event/evidence record and derived state transition must be committed atomically or reconciled through an explicit recovery path.

failureRules: External failure must not be represented as success without verified evidence.
Retries must respect operation idempotency characteristics.
A timeout is not proof of success.
Provider output is not automatically canonical truth.
Findings that require authority are recorded and escalated rather than silently corrected.
